title: Cyber Factory
summary: A synthetic security-telemetry lab that tests local models on cross-source incident triage and preserves a second-model critique as an explainability trail.
epitaph: The factory produced evidence before it produced a platform.
revive_when: You want to test a security agent against labeled multi-stage scenarios, and can add ground truth before adding more models or infrastructure.

related.reason: Both make evidence explicit: Cyber Factory records which log lines support a verdict, while Problem Space separates levels of understanding and connects claims to their problem context.
